limits: no L05 dispatcher lease or writer token
no approved raw DAT/source archive opened in this run
no SY_* rows or executable config bodies inspected or executed
no legacy database/config write or migration
no product/compiler runtime test or CI
no GitHub mutation or issue closure
objective: Keep compiled DAT/config output non-executable until exact source, compiler, scope, authority and previous-good recovery evidence are all verified at one head.

requirements.requirement: Approved archive/build identity and the complete qualified source-set manifest are exact-hash verified.
Every selected DAT/SY source carries tenant/company/FID/variant/PFID and persisted identity without basename or timestamp authority.
Consumer-specific grammar and encoding are versioned; unknown fields remain quarantined and losslessly evidenced.
Compiler binary/source/dependency identity and bounded parser limits are attested at the exact implementation head.
Executable-looking SQL, script, hook, type and path fields have reviewed typed contracts; unknown execution surfaces are denied.
Compiled output is presentation-only unless an independently authorized server action/capability binding exists.
Publisher epoch, source manifest hash, compiler version and output hash are atomically bound to one immutable candidate.
Admission uses expected-current CAS and rejects stale, mixed-generation, incomplete or ambiguous candidates.
Previous-good remains active on compile, validation, publication, cache-convergence or acknowledgement failure.
Rollback is compatibility-checked and changes only an immutable configuration pointer, never capability or business data.
Runtime evaluation is bounded in a disposable target and proves no file, network, arbitrary type, SQL or script escape.
Independent review approves the exact source/build/compiler/output/head tuple and all unresolved executable surfaces remain blocked.

adversarial_cases.fault: one DAT member is absent from an otherwise valid manifest
same basename resolves from two qualified paths
adversarial_cases.expected: ambiguity quarantined; neither newest timestamp nor path order selects authority

adversarial_cases.fault: SY row or DAT content changes after compile but before publish
adversarial_cases.expected: source-set/output binding mismatch rejects before activation

adversarial_cases.fault: compiler or dependency version differs from the reviewed attestation
adversarial_cases.expected: candidate cannot execute even when output bytes happen to match

adversarial_cases.fault: unknown hook, SQL-like field, script, type name or path appears
adversarial_cases.expected: deny execution; preserve only bounded non-executable evidence

adversarial_cases.fault: presentation metadata attempts to grant capability or widen company/warehouse scope
adversarial_cases.expected: deny at authoritative server boundary; configuration is not permission

adversarial_cases.fault: stale publisher wins after a newer immutable version is current
adversarial_cases.expected: expected-current CAS rejects stale epoch with no pointer change

adversarial_cases.fault: lost publish acknowledgement leaves outcome uncertain
adversarial_cases.expected: reconcile authoritative pointer/output hash before retry; no automatic replay

adversarial_cases.fault: rollback candidate targets incompatible grammar, build or retired executable contract
adversarial_cases.expected: rollback rejected; current compatible previous-good remains active

adversarial_cases.fault: one client retains a stale legacy cache after publication
adversarial_cases.expected: fleet activation remains incomplete until measured convergence; Web invalidation is insufficient

admission_rule: All EXE-01..12 must be independently verified at one exact head; any drift returns to BLOCKED_NO_EXECUTABLE_DAT_ADMISSION.
